Because HBeAg-positive patients are zero after checking standard concepts, source fields, and cohort definitions, the requested stratified comparison is not directly estimable. I’ll compute the closest sensitivity analysis in chronic HBV patients regardless of HBeAg status.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH chb AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (439674,192240)
    UNION SELECT 439674 UNION SELECT 192240
  )
), drug_classed AS (
  SELECT d.person_id, d.drug_exposure_start_date,
         CASE
           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1729323,19011093) AND ca.descendant_concept_id=d.drug_concept_id)
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1711246,1704183,1758392) AND ca.descendant_concept_id=d.drug_concept_id)
             THEN 'nucleotide'
           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1711246,1704183,1758392) AND ca.descendant_concept_id=d.drug_concept_id)
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1729323,19011093) AND ca.descendant_concept_id=d.drug_concept_id)
             THEN 'nucleoside'
           ELSE 'mixed'
         END AS regimen_class
  FROM omop.drug_exposure d
  JOIN chb c ON c.person_id=d.person_id
  WHERE d.drug_concept_id IN (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (1729323,19011093,1711246,1704183,1758392)
  )
), first_date AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM drug_classed
  GROUP BY person_id
), index_class AS (
  SELECT fd.person_id, fd.index_date,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT dc.regimen_class)=1 THEN MIN(dc.regimen_class) ELSE 'mixed' END AS regimen_class
  FROM first_date fd
  JOIN drug_classed dc ON dc.person_id=fd.person_id AND dc.drug_exposure_start_date=fd.index_date
  GROUP BY fd.person_id, fd.index_date
), follow_hbv AS (
  SELECT i.person_id, i.regimen_class,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m.value_as_concept_id IN (9189,9190,45878583,45880296)
                   OR UPPER(COALESCE(m.value_source_value,'')) LIKE '%NOT DETECTED%'
                   OR UPPER(COALESCE(m.value_source_value,'')) LIKE '%UNDETECT%'
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS undetectable_180,
         COUNT(*) AS hbv_dna_tests_180
  FROM index_class i
  JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id=i.person_id
    AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (3027346,3046542,3032567,3022058,36660207,3026949,3049385,3052981,3048505)
    AND m.measurement_date >= i.index_date
    AND m.measurement_date <= DATEADD(day,180,i.index_date)
  WHERE i.regimen_class IN ('nucleotide','nucleoside')
  GROUP BY i.person_id, i.regimen_class
)
SELECT regimen_class,
       COUNT(*) AS patients_with_hbv_dna_followup_180d,
       SUM(undetectable_180) AS patients_undetectable_by_180d,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(undetectable_180)/COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS undetectable_rate_pct
FROM follow_hbv
GROUP BY regimen_class
ORDER BY regimen_class
